GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-07-20T12:40:43Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: What is ServiceId & DeploymentId when running under Service Fabric?
Description: I wanted to ask what we should be setting these to be while running under service fabric? Our deployment would look something like the following. We have one silo "Silo A" that is responsible for grains 1 & 2. The silo will be deployed on 3 nodes in the service fabric cluster.

- Node 1
-- Silo A
--- Grain 1
--- Grain 2
- Node 2
-- Silo A
--- Grain 1
--- Grain 2
- Node 3
-- Silo A
--- Grain 1
--- Grain 2

DeploymentId is required for the Azure Queue stream provider so I need to set it to something. However, i wasnt sure what the semantics were around these two values and what they control.
